sloka: यदि किंचिदनुक्रोशस्तस्य मय्यस्ति धीमतः ।यदि वा भाग्यशेषो मे शीतो भव हनूमतः ।। 5.53.29।।।।
transliteration: yadi kiṁcidanukrośastasya mayyasti dhīmataḥ ।yadi vā bhāgyaśeṣo me śīto bhava hanūmataḥ ।। 5.53.29।।।।

translations.english: "If wise Rama has some compassion for me, if there is any residue of good luck for me, to Hanuman be cool O Firegod.
